instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-25_input.step. Keep the circular flange outside diameter 148 mm and thickness 18 mm. Cut a center through hole of diameter 44 mm. On a bolt circle radius of 54 mm, cut eight through holes every 45 degrees starting on +X. The holes at 0, 90, 180, and 270 degrees are diameter 8 mm and have bottom counterbores of diameter 16 mm and depth 5 mm. The holes at 45, 135, 225, and 315 degrees are diameter 10 mm and have top counterbores of diameter 18 mm and depth 5 mm. Export /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-25_output.step.
